data.narrative:
Mara is a pre-seed stage company in the Defense & Security sector that has raised $1.6M to date. The valuation universe comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including notably funded companies such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two primary valuation methods were evaluated for applicability. Stage-Progression analysis was not pursued: the method's implied valuation of $750M exceeded 20x the company's total capital raised, suggesting the underlying base value derived from funding-tracker data was unreliable. Peer-Median analysis was likewise not applicable, as the Defense & Security peer set yielded insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—only one adjacent-stage peer was identified from the narrow filtered universe, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum threshold required for statistical robustness.

The constrained analytical framework means no quantitative triangulation can be responsibly supported from available data. Valuation guidance at this stage would require either: (i) reliable bottom-up financial projections from the company; (ii) a broader set of same-stage or near-stage comparable transactions in the Defense & Security space; or (iii) founder and investor input on recent valuation discussions. Without these inputs, any point estimate would rest on inference rather than evidence and should not be relied upon for investment decision-making.
